species.name: White bass
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 16–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
East wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
